paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
notes: Ferromagnetic axion haloscope (QUAX prototype) sets upper limit on axion-electron coupling g_aee < 4.9e-10 at 95% C.L. for m_a=58 ueV (14 GHz). Limit extends over a ~3 MHz range around 14 GHz; only the central best value is explicitly given in text. DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
